data.narrative: The student demonstrated a strong grasp of production observability by instrumenting a Python API with structlog and prometheus_client. They successfully navigated the BREAK step by accurately diagnosing three silent failure modes, proving they understand how cardinality limits and context binding work under the hood.

dimension_scores.observation: Carried over from Mod 3. Image optimization and multi-stage builds remain solid.
Carried over from Mod 3. CI/CD integration remains solid.

Successfully implemented all three pillars of observability: structured logging with environment-aware formatting, pull-based metrics exposing counters and histograms, and clear Prometheus alerting rules.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created app/logger.py with structlog, app/main.py with prometheus_client middleware, and artifacts/observability/alerts.yml

dimension_scores.observation: Diagnosed the three failure modes (Silent Failure, Cardinality Bomb, Missing Request ID) without hints by analyzing how data drops between the HTTP layer and the logger.
dimension_scores.evidence: Correctly identified that adding a user_id label to Prometheus counters causes memory exhaustion.

dimension_scores.observation: Not yet tested in this module. Module 5 and 6 will focus entirely on graceful degradation and circuit breakers.
Authored alerting rules with clear, human-readable annotations that explain the exact threshold breached and provide actionable context for an on-call engineer.
dimension_scores.evidence: Wrote the HighErrorRate alert description: 'The service has an error rate of over 5% for the last 5 minutes.'

strengths: Understanding cardinality risks in time-series databases
data.recommendation: In Module 5, apply this same rigorous systems-thinking to external dependency failures (e.g., how the application behaves when the database times out).

public_evidence.student_action: Instrumented a Python API with structlog (JSON/Hybrid) and Prometheus middleware, and defined production alerting rules.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Implemented structlog.contextvars to bind UUID request IDs to all log events, preventing silent failures. Added prometheus_client middleware to expose /metrics for pull-based scraping without introducing high-cardinality label bombs.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the candidate can build applications that are actually operable in production by establishing the triad of logs, metrics, and actionable alerts, while avoiding common pitfalls like cardinality explosion.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Diagnosed that unique identifiers in metric labels crash time-series databases.
Used structlog contextvars to tie request lifecycles together.

teaching_approaches.detail: Presented symptoms of silent failures to force diagnostic reasoning.

learning_style_signals: Learns well by diagnosing systemic failures (BREAK step)
